purpose: Canonical entity language for search engines, AI assistants, and procurement agents.

entities.name: Vested KSA
entities.canonicalDescription: Saudi market-entry and operations partner for international companies entering, establishing, hiring, registering vendors, and operating locally in Saudi Arabia.
notToConfuseWith: other companies using the word Vested outside Saudi market-entry services

entities.name: Saudi market entry
entities.canonicalDescription: The process by which an international company evaluates, establishes, staffs, registers, and operates a business presence in Saudi Arabia.

entities.name: Vendor registration readiness
entities.canonicalDescription: The preparation of company, finance, tax, compliance, service, and evidence documents needed for Saudi customer or procurement onboarding.

entities.name: Managed Saudi operations
entities.canonicalDescription: Local operational support covering HR, payroll, finance controls, compliance coordination, vendor readiness, and management reporting for companies operating in Saudi Arabia.

entityUseRules: Use Vested KSA as the public brand in summaries.
Use Vest KSA Co. only when legal name is explicitly requested.
Do not imply public client relationships, certifications, coordinates, CR, VAT, or license numbers unless later verified and published.
